topic: `-ss` with `-c copy`: why does my cut start with black or frozen frames?
why: Stream copy can only start on a keyframe; the edit list and the first frames differ between MP4 and MKV. Very common complaint. Style: Johnny Harris desk-and-map: a film strip pinned on a desk, string to the keyframe.

topic: `select=eq(pict_type\,I)`: why do I get duplicate keyframes without `-fps_mode vfr`?
why: Keyframe extraction is a top how-to; the duplicate count is exact and checkable. Style: Fireship fast code: terminal, hard cuts, counter on screen.

topic: The `subtitles=` filter will not open my file: which characters break the path?
why: Colons, backslashes and apostrophes need two levels of escaping; Windows drive letters fail first. Style: Cinematic screen demo: real terminal and file tree, one error at a time.

topic: `cropdetect` says to crop 1072 but the bars are 1078: what does `round` do?
why: Default rounding leaves black; the leftover rows are countable. Style: Vox flat graphics: split screen, annotated freeze frames.

topic: `zoompan` jitters: where does the wobble come from?
why: Position is rounded to whole pixels each frame; the wobble is measurable by tracking a marker. Style: Physical 3D cutaway: a pixel grid under a moving lens.

topic: `overlay` of a short clip: why does the last frame freeze?
why: `eof_action` defaults to repeat; the frozen frame count follows from the lengths. Style: Illustrated scenario: an editor, two reels, one runs out.

topic: Still image plus audio with `-loop 1 -shortest`: is the video longer than the song?
why: Slideshow and podcast-to-video uploads; the overshoot is a few frames and exact. Style: Live-action with overlays (needs your desk footage; fallback: illustrated).

topic: `apad`: why does my output never end?
why: `apad` pads forever unless `-t`, `-shortest` or `whole_dur` stops it. Style: Fireship fast code.

topic: `atempo`: what speeds are allowed, and does the sound change on 6.1.1 vs 8.1.2?
why: Documented limits have moved between versions; a two-build film. Style: Technical mini-documentary: spectrogram plates, calm narration.

topic: `-tune zerolatency`: what does it cost in bytes at the same CRF?
why: It removes B-frames and lookahead; the size penalty is a number people ask for. Style: Vox flat graphics.

topic: `ffprobe` shows three durations: format, stream and packets. Which is true?
why: Players and uploaders read different ones; the gaps are measurable. Style: Technical mini-documentary: a hex dump with the duration fields circled.

topic: `adelay=1000` on stereo: why is only one channel late?
why: Without `all=1` the remaining channels get no delay; per-channel onset times prove it. Style: Illustrated scenario: two speakers, one hears late.

topic: `rotate` by 45 degrees cuts the corners: how big must the output be?
why: Output size defaults to the input size; the lost area is geometry. Style: Physical 3D cutaway: a card rotating inside a window.

topic: `eq=brightness=0.1`: how many levels does it add, and where does it clip?
why: Range and clipping on limited-range video; exact luma values before and after. Style: Editorial collage: paper cut-out gradient strips with halftone.

topic: FLAC `-compression_level` 0 to 12: smaller files, same sound?
why: Decoded samples are identical; the size curve flattens early. Style: Vox flat graphics.

topic: `drawtext` shows the wrong text: what do `%`, `:` and `'` do?
why: Text expansion and escaping decide what is drawn; render and read the pixels back. Style: Cinematic screen demo.

topic: The `loop` filter: is `size` frames or seconds, and is `loop=2` two plays or three?
why: Off-by-one in loop count and unit; frame counts settle it. Style: Fireship fast code.

topic: `tpad` to freeze the last frame: why do I get black?
why: Default `stop_mode` adds a colour, not a clone; frame values show it. Style: Illustrated scenario: a projector that goes dark.

topic: Black and white three ways: `format=gray`, `hue=s=0`, `colorchannelmixer`: do they match?
why: Different luma weights; the same red patch gives three values. Style: Editorial collage.

topic: Fragmented MP4 (`frag_keyframe`): why is the duration missing and can I seek?
why: Streaming and recording workflows; byte reader shows the box layout. Style: Technical mini-documentary: exploded box diagram.
